units.source_text: 翌日的对局室设在二楼，那里的陈设古色古香，很有明治时代的气氛。

en.t: The next day's game room was set up on the second floor, where the furnishings had an antique elegance and a strong Meiji-era atmosphere.

units.source_text: 从隔扇到气窗全饰有红叶，围在一角的金色屏风也绘上了光琳 [2] 风格的艳丽红叶。

en.t: From the sliding doors to the transom windows, everything was decorated with maple leaves, and the gold folding screens enclosing one corner were also painted with brilliant maple leaves in the Korin [2] style.

units.source_text: 璧龛里插有八角金盘和西番莲。

en.t: In the wall alcove were arranged fatsia leaves and passionflowers.

units.source_text: 整个套间—一间十八叠，一间十五叠—都打通了，大朵花也并不刺眼。

en.t: The whole suite, one room of eighteen tatami mats and one of fifteen, had been opened into a single space, and even the large blossoms did not seem garish.

units.source_text: 西番莲的花有点凋谢了。

en.t: The passionflowers had begun to wilt a little.

units.source_text: 只有梳着发 [3] 插上花簪的少女，不时前来换茶。

en.t: Only a young girl with her hair dressed [3] and a flower hairpin inserted came now and then to replace the tea.

units.source_text: 此外再没有别人进出了。

en.t: Apart from her, no one else came in or went out.

units.source_text: 名人的白扇子映在盛着冰水的黑漆盘里，静中有动。

en.t: The Master's white fan was reflected in the black lacquer tray filled with ice water, giving movement within the stillness.
I was the only observer of the game.
